definitions: To dissolve out or extract (soluble constituents from a material) by the action of a percolating liquid.
To remove (a substance) from a material by the action of a percolating liquid.
To drain away from soil, ash, or similar material by the action of percolating liquid.
examples: The rain will leach nutrients from the soil.
Heavy rainfall can leach out the pesticides.
Minerals leach from the rocks into the water.
